sampling: SHA256(seed + LF + source word and canonical reading), ascending; unique Chinese surface; no statistical model output used for labels
scope: declared standard-layout runs with one or two explicit tones; dictionary-guided synthetic Chinese intentions and synthetic literal intentions
independence: Generated near-duplicates share their actual template family. No UUID or row ID family is used to manufacture independent groups. Component and test counts may consequently fail pilot/release adequacy; this is preserved as a negative data-qualification result.
labels: Chinese readings transcribed from checked-in public dictionary source entries; raw keys are mechanical Standard spellings. Literal prototypes are deliberately artificial. Mandatory labels are hand-transcribed from source tests and contract. Ambiguous alternatives are explicitly both literal and Chinese.
data_expansion_rule: Never append samples after quality outcomes to satisfy a confidence bound. Any later dataset requires a new version and preserves this result.

public_usbids.rule: all exact ASCII whitespace-delimited tokens matching [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,46} and containing a digit; vendor-family grouping; Latin-1 byte map; no spelling transformation
public_usbids.attribution: Linux USB ID Repository, maintained by the USB ID database contributors; see upstream README/LICENSE

pre_quality_grouping_correction.reason: broad Chinese coverage categories are not near-duplicate lexical prototypes; parent source review before any policy outcomes; retained literal fixed-tail templates and actual word/prefix/source/context edges

public_pciids.rule: all direct-device original ASCII tokens using the identical USB rule; vendor/manufacturer family grouping; no more sources after this acquisition
public_pciids.attribution: Martin Mares, Albert Pool and PCI ID Project contributors
